manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the first the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl and layer the rest above it.

Task description: Stack the three small bowls with brown rims on the table, using the first bowl at the lower right and toward the front of the current view as the base, with the other two stacked above it.

Success criteria: Form a compact stack of three bowls on the table, with adjacent bowl bodies approximately aligned horizontally. The bottom bowl must be near the table and the upper two fully nested low, with no conspicuous suspension of the stack. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above the bowl opening and choose a rim section away from adjacent bowls with space both inside and outside. Use one finger inside and one outside to grip the thin wall below the rim, matching the opening to local thickness and pad clearance.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on the inside and outside of the bowl wall, with the pads contacting the wall rather than only pressing on its narrow rim. During a short lift, check for slipping or tilt.
- The two bowls on the right are close together. Keep the gripper clear of the narrow gap between them during grasping and turning. Keep the bowl opening upward, and lift its base above the neighboring rim before moving sideways.
- First align the upper bowl bottom within the lower opening, then lower slowly. If one rim contacts first and tilts the bowl, lift slightly and adjust laterally rather than pressing onto the rim and forming a tall, crooked stack.
- Before releasing, make sure the lower bowl securely supports the upper one and check whether an inner finger is trapped between them. After release, withdraw in a direction with clearance to avoid catching the rim and moving the stack.
